notes:
POC / performance evaluation notes:
- Use-cases: multi-tenant customer-support chat (primary), embeddings for knowledge search, reranking for search results, summarization of transaction logs.
- Willowbrook UX constraint: p95 end-to-end generation latency must be <= 200ms for short responses (<=64 tokens) -- CTO quote: 'If p95 >200ms we see measurable drop in CSAT.'
- Throughput targets requested: sustain 120 RPS steady-state for 512-token context workload; support 200 concurrent streaming sessions during peak with graceful degrade to cheaper model variant.
- Throughput guarantee ask: reserved capacity that can handle 1.8M tokens/hour sustained (approx), with predictable autoscale/burst policy.
- Latency SLOs discussed: p50 <60ms, p95 <200ms, p99 <350ms for typical chat payloads. Must include defined credits for SLA miss.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial recommendation from SE: 6 x H100-equivalent for production pilot (to meet concurrency/throughput targets) with autoscale to +2 GPUs for bursts; Willowbrook asked for cost per-GPU/month estimates and a 12-month commit discount schedule.
- POC tests executed: cold-start latency profiling, kernel-selection microbenchmarks, continuous batching behavior, KV cache hit-rate measurement, prefix-caching for repeated prompts, and 72-hour soak under mixed read/write pattern.
- Representative prompts used in load tests: (shortened)
    * 'User: I lost my card, what do I do? — assign case, list steps, provide FAQ links'
    * 'Summarize last 20 transactions for account 1234 for AML review'
    * 'Rank 10 candidate help-articles for query: "how to dispute a charge"'
    * embedding similarity queries: 1000 QPS synthetic similarity checks against 200k vector index
- Success criteria: meets latency SLOs >=95% of samples during soak; error rate <0.1%; cost per 1M tokens <= threshold in pricing deck; no unplanned restarts in 72h soak.
- Observations from soak run: average p95 at 180-210ms (borderline), p99 spikes during network peering rekey events; KV cache reduced token compute by ~28% on repeated sequences; batching increased throughput but introduced 10-20ms additional median latency for single-turn flows.
- SE notes/action items: tune batching window for low-latency chat, enable prefix caching for high-reuse dialogs, add canary fallback policy to smaller quantized model for overload.
- Security/compliance: Willowbrook requires SSO/SAML, KMS integration for envelope keys, audit logging retention 7 years for certain financial traces. Data residency: must ensure EU customer subset remains in eu-1 region.
- Legal: negotiating SLA clause around latency crediting and scheduled maintenance windows. Willowbrook legal requests a 30-day termination right for pilot.
- Quote from Willowbrook infra lead in call: 'Need deterministic throughput so ops metrics can predict monthly billing and capacity planning.'
- Open questions: exact EU subset definition, acceptance criteria for reranking quality regressions, final reserved GPU count after second round of kernel tuning.
- Links: drive pricing deck + security FAQ attached. Fireflies notes for calls attached. Jira tickets created for network peering (INF-3478) and kernel regression investigation (INF-3421).
